sources.title: Broncos had a formal interview with Texas A&M WR KC Concepcion at the Combine
sources.description: According to the Denver Posts Luca Evans, the Denver Broncos held a formal interview with Texas A&M wide receiver KC Concepcion at the NFL Scouting Combine. KC Concepcion is one of the more electric wide receivers in the 2026 NFL Draft. He is not the fastest player in the draft, but he possesses excellent acceleration […]
